title: The Basic tool for the job
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：basic　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 basic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the director wrote of ① a basic tool for the job in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② more basic than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the basic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most basic tool for the job anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too basic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the basic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a basic knowledge of the law, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as basic as the knowledge of the law they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was basic or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something basic, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite basic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the basic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, for the whole place, she wrote of another basic tool for the job in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more basic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most basic knowledge of the law in the whole theatre, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the basic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 基本（前置定语 a basic tool for the job：1986 年导演在戏报里记下的那件基本的家什）
B. adj. 基本／起码（比较级 more basic than：文中两处，一处比干活的家什，一处比预想）
C. adj. 基本／起码（最高级 the most basic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 基本（表语 too basic to do：母亲觉得它太基本，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 起码（前置定语 a basic knowledge of the law：叔叔把整件事称作一桩起码的法律常识）
F. adj. 起码（同级比较 as basic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩法律常识相比）
G. adj. 起码（后置定语 something basic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 起码（受程度副词修饰 quite basic：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a basic tool for the job
the most basic tool for the job anybody
a basic knowledge of the law
The most basic knowledge of the law in

answers.why: basic 意为“基本”，1986 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件基本的家什”，此处作前置定语 a basic tool for the job。
basic 意为“基本”，此处用比较级 more basic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
basic 意为“基本”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最基本的一件，故用最高级 the most basic tool for the job。
basic 意为“基本”，母亲认为这件东西“太基本了，谁也用不上”，too basic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
basic 意为“起码”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩起码的法律常识”，此处作前置定语 a basic knowledge of the law。
basic 意为“起码”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩法律常识一样起码”，同级比较用 as basic as。
basic 意为“起码”，戏报上那半行字要的是“起码的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something basic。
basic 意为“起码”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当起码”，quite 修饰原级 basic。
basic 意为“起码”，1996 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要起码”，故用比较级 more basic than。
basic 意为“起码”，母亲 1998 年说的是“整个戏院里最起码的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most basic knowledge of the law。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件基本的家什。（a basic tool for the job）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更基本。（more basic than …）
母亲觉得它太基本，谁也用不上。（too basic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩起码的法律常识。（a basic knowledge of the law）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩法律常识一样起码。（as basic as …）
到了 1993 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件起码的东西。（something basic）
answers: In 1986 the director wrote of a basic tool for the job in the poster.
Everybody said it was more basic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too basic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a basic knowledge of the law.
He said nobody would call it as basic as the knowledge of the law they had once had.
By 1993 the poster asked for nothing but something basic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 basic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the director wrote of a basic tool for the job in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most basic tool for the job in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too basic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a basic knowledge of the law, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite basic, and everybody laughed.
The basic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
